title: Loss of the Asn333 high-mannose N-glycan impairs ACP3 folding and drives disease-associated dysfunction.
authors: Manabe, Noriyoshi; Itoh, Kazuyoshi; Ohno, Shiho; Miura, Ayumi; Miyata, Aika; Yashima, Sora; Komatsu, Sachiko; Fujimura, Tsutomu; Hanamatsu, Hisatoshi; Furukawa, Jun-Ichi; Angata, Kiyohiko; Togayachi, Akira; Aoki-Kinoshita, Kiyoko F; Akimoto, Yoshihiro; Kaname, Tadashi; Nishihara, Shoko; Yamaguchi, Yoshiki
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子动力学模拟研究ACP3蛋白Asn333糖基化位点对折叠稳定性的结构作用，虽以糖蛋白为对象，但MD模拟方法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算研究。
abstract: Missense mutations disrupting N-glycosylation motifs can perturb protein folding and trafficking, yet the site-specific contributions of individual N-glycans to proteostasis remain poorly defined. Here, we delineated the functional hierarchy of three N-glycosylation sites in human prostatic acid phosphatase (ACP3). Glycoproteomic analysis showed that Asn94 and Asn220 carry predominantly complex-type N-glycans, whereas Asn333 is enriched in high-mannose structures. Glycan-deficient N94Q and N220Q variants were efficiently secreted and retained phosphatase activity, whereas N333Q and T335M accumulated intracellularly, formed endoplasmic reticulum aggregates, and lacked enzymatic activity. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that the Asn333 high-mannose glycan forms persistent hydrogen-bond networks with surrounding residues and exhibits markedly reduced conformational flexibility, supporting a non-redundant structural role. Individuals harboring a heterozygous p.T335M variant presented severe neurodevelopmental abnormalities, linking Asn333 glycan loss to proteostasis failure in vivo. These findings establish a site-specific glycan-protein stabilizing mechanism with broad implications in glycoprotein folding and human disease.
abstract_zh: 错义突变破坏N-糖基化基序可干扰蛋白质折叠和运输，然而单个N-聚糖对蛋白质稳态的位点特异性贡献仍不明确。在此，我们描绘了人前列腺酸性磷酸酶（ACP3）中三个N-糖基化位点的功能层级。糖蛋白组学分析显示，Asn94和Asn220主要携带复杂型N-聚糖，而Asn333富含高甘露糖结构。缺乏聚糖的N94Q和N220Q变体被有效分泌并保留磷酸酶活性，而N333Q和T335M在细胞内积累，形成内质网聚集体，并缺乏酶活性。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟揭示，Asn333高甘露糖聚糖与周围残基形成持久氢键网络，并表现出显著降低的构象灵活性，支持其非冗余的结构作用。携带杂合p.T335M变体的个体表现出严重的神经发育异常，将Asn333聚糖缺失与体内蛋白质稳态失败联系起来。这些发现确立了一种位点特异性聚糖-蛋白质稳定机制，对糖蛋白折叠和人类疾病具有广泛意义。
